value.syntax: # [doc = " One explicit evidence output located by public identifiers on one observed chain."] # [doc = " (´def:wallet:settlement-evidence´)"] # [derive (Clone , Copy , Debug , Eq , PartialEq)] pub struct Evidence { # [doc = " Display-order transaction identifier."] pub transaction : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Output index of the evidence output."] pub output : u32 , # [doc = " Display-order hash of the block claimed to include the transaction."] pub block : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Height claimed for that block."] pub height : u64 , # [doc = " Explicit amount selected by the evidence decoder."] pub amount : u64 , }
